# Story 09 — a React skeleton: router, auth context, client, loading hook (Story: CRM-24)

## Prerequisites

- **PLATFORM-6-API (CRM-21) shipped** — the API

mounts under `/api/v1`, so the client's base URL is fixed. The intake's "cannot ship before" points to it.
- **PLATF

ORM-7-API (CRM-22) shipped** — the served route table is the contract this client talks to.
- **Sprint-0 branch already exists**

— created by Story 01 (repo conventions). Cut a story branch from `sprint-0` per `docs/git.md`.
- **`.squad/plan-lessons.md` read**
— L-1 (full-name story ids), L-4 (respect Out-of-scope), L-8 (do not compute tracker keys — cite `
IDENTITY-1-API (CRM-41)` and `PLATFORM-10-WEB (CRM-25)` because the intake supplies those keys; leave `PLATFORM-11-WEB`,
`PLATFORM-12-WEB`, `PLATFORM-15-ALL` un-keyed), L-9 (the API's error body carries `code` + `requestId` only
— the client surfaces the code, never invents a sentence), L-10 / L-13 (no source-text scans in

this story; the import-direction check is PLATFORM-15-ALL's script).
- Read at least one prior plan for tone — the

earlier platform stories (`.squad/stories/platform/CRM-16` … `CRM-23`) set the pattern.

---

## Story Goal

St
and up the `web/` root as an empty single-page **Vite + React + TypeScript** application with just enough seams for every

later web story to sit on top of it:

1. A router that resolves on boot.
2. An auth context that reads a **stubbed** token from `

localStorage` on boot, so a signed-in session survives a reload.
3. A route guard that sends an unauthenticated visitor to `/sign-in`.
4. A `/sign-in` page (an unstyled form, **

no real endpoint**).
5. An HTTP client that talks to `/api/v1/*`, understands the `{ code, requestId }` error body

from `api/src/platform/http/errors.js`, and surfaces the **code** on failure (never a generic "something went wrong").
6. A single loading hook in

`shared/` that owns `{ status, data, error, run }` — used by every screen that arrives after this one.

**Out of scope (see the intake):** real s
ign-in (**IDENTITY-1-API (CRM-41)** owns the endpoint), design tokens / colours / UI primitives (**PLATFORM-10-WEB (CRM-
25)**), the full test setup (**PLATFORM-11-WEB**), the desk shell (**PLATFORM-12-WEB**), the structure-direction check script (**PLATFORM-15-ALL**), any feature scre

en.

---

## Context — Read These Files First

1. `.squad/plan-lessons.md` — the whole file. Non-negotiable input to every plan.
2. `

.squad/stories/platform/CRM-24/intake.md` — the intake, including the **Technical hints** and **Out of scope** blocks that steer this story.
3. `docs/archit
ecture.md` — section **"The web"** (~lines 63–90). It fixes the stack (Vite, React, TypeScript, Vitest + Testing Library), the layer set (`app
→ pages → features → entities → shared`), the import direction, and the `@x/<consumer>` rule for sibling entity slices. Do not restate; ob

ey.
4. `docs/taxonomy.md` — confirms feature slugs and id format; the plan cites `PLATFORM-N-L

AYER` ids in full.
5. `api/src/platform/http/errors.js` — read end-to-end. The client must recognise:
   - The frozen `DOCUMENTED
` map (lines 15–24): eight statuses (400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 422, 429, 500) with their

codes.
   - The response body shape (lines 82–90): `{ code, requestId }`, plus `fields: string[]` **only** at 422 (never a value).
6. `api/src/platform

/http/errors.test.js` — skim to see how the API constructs and surfaces those codes, so the client's tests use the same vocabulary.
7. `scripts/cri

teria/platform.md` — section `## PLATFORM-9-WEB` (lines 131–144). The five acceptance criteria are binding.
8. `scripts/backlog.tx
t` — line 28 (`STORY 9|react-skeleton|…`) confirms the story id and its
need on `PLT-6-API`. Line 29–34 confirm the ids of the follow-on stories c

ited here.
9. `web/.gitkeep` — the only current inhabitant of `web/`. This story fills the root; nothing is inherited.

10. `api/package.json` — do **not** modify. This story adds `web/package.json` as its own root.

---

## Product rules (from story)

- **Current beh

aviour:** `web/` is empty.
- **New behaviour:**
  - The application boots at `/` and routes resolve.
  - An **unauthenticated** visitor is

redirected to `/sign-in`.
  - A visitor whose `localStorage` carries the stub auth token is treated as authenticated on boot,

so a reload keeps them past the guard.
  - A failed API call rejects with an `ApiError` whose `.code` is the API's frozen code (`BAD_REQUEST`, `UNAUTHEN

TICATED`, `NOT_FOUND`, `VALIDATION_FAILED`, …). The **code**, not a sentence, is what screens render.
  -
Every screen calls one shared hook to run a request and expose `{ status, data, error }`. A screen that reimplements loading state

is the failure.
  - Layer imports point downward only: `app → pages → features → entities → shared`. The **check** that

polices this is not built here (**PLATFORM-15-ALL**). This story merely obeys the direction.

---

## Implementation t

asks

> The runtime is **Node 26**. Pin every package to a version compatible with Node 26. Do not run `npm create vite` from a

template — enumerate the files below by hand so the plan and the disk agree.

### 1 — Create the `web/` root

#### Create file:

`web/package.json`

- `"name": "web"`, `"private": true`, `"type": "module"`.
- **Dependencies** (pin exact versions):
  - `react`, `react-dom` —

React 18.x line.
  - `react-router-dom` — v6.x line.
- **Dev dependencies**:
  - `typescript` — 5.x.
  - `vite` —

latest 5.x supporting Node 26.
  - `@vitejs/plugin-react`.
  - `vitest`, `@vitest/ui` (optional), `jsdom`

.
  - `@testing-library/react`, `@testing-library/user-event`, `@testing-library/jest-dom`.
  - `@types/react`, `@types/react-dom`, `@types/node`.
- **Scripts**: `"
dev": "vite"`, `"build": "tsc -b && vite build"`, `"preview": "vite preview"`, `"test": "vitest run"`, `"test:watch": "vitest"`,

`"typecheck": "tsc -b --noEmit"`.
- **Do not** add any lint or format tool here; that belongs to a later story.
- **Do not

** add any mention of AI tools, models, or assistants anywhere in this file.

#### Create file: `web/vite.config.ts`

- Import `@vitejs/plugin-react`.
- `server`: `port: 5173`, `proxy: { '/api': 'http://localhost:3000' }` (or whichever port `api/src/server.js` binds). Confirm the port

by reading `api/src/server.js` before writing the value.
- `test`: `environment: 'jsdom'`, `setupFiles: ['./

src/testing/setup.ts']`, `globals: true`.

#### Create file: `web/tsconfig.json`

- `"strict": true`, `"target": "ES2022"`, `"module": "ESNext"`, `"moduleResolution":
"bundler"`, `"jsx": "react-jsx"`, `"types": ["vite/client", "vitest/globals", "@testing-library/jest-dom"]`.

- `include: ["src"]`. #### Create file: `web/index.html` - Single `
` and a `

othing else. No inline styles, no colour literal.

#### Create file: `web/.gitignore`

- `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `.vite/`, `coverage/`.

Nothing that mentions AI tooling.

Delete `web/.gitkeep` once real files land in `web/`.

### 2 — Comp

ose root: `web/src/main.tsx` and `web/src/app/`

The **`app/` layer** owns providers, the
router, and the auth context (per `docs/architecture.md` line 67). Only create the layer folders this story fills; do not scaffold empty `features/` or `entities/` y

et.

#### Create file: `web/src/main.tsx`

- Mount `<React.StrictMode>` → `<App />` on `document.getElementById('root')`.

#### Create file: `web/src/app/App.tsx`

-

Compose in order: `<BrowserRouter>` → `<AuthProvider>` → `<AppRoutes />`.
- No colour, no inline style

. Plain markup.

#### Create file: `web/src/app/routes.tsx` (`AppRoutes`)

- `/sign-in` → the sign-in page (public

matched path → redirect to `/`.
- Do **not** import from `pages/` upward. Routes import p

ages; nothing else does.

#### Create file: `web/src/app/auth-context.tsx`

- Export `AuthProvider` and `useAuth`.
- Shape: `{ token: string | null,

signIn(token: string): void, signOut(): void, isAuthenticated: boolean }`.
- Storage key: a single module-level constant (e.g. `AUTH_TOKEN_K

EY = 'support-desk.auth-token'`).
- On mount, **read** the token synchronously via `readStoredToken()` and initialise state

. This is the seam that makes a reload survive.
- `signIn(token)` writes to `localStorage` and updates state; `signOut()` removes it.
- **Say cl
early in a top-of-file comment:** the token is a **stub** for this story. **IDENTITY-1-API (CRM-41)** replaces the stub with a real token issued by the API.

Until then, `signIn(anyNonEmptyString)` counts as signed in.

#### Create file: `web/src/app/require-auth.tsx`

- A

component that reads `useAuth()`; if `!isAuthenticated`, renders `<Navigate to="/sign-in" replace state={{ from: location }} />`.
- Otherwise renders `props

.children`.

### 3 — The sign-in page (stub)

#### Create file: `web/src/pages/sign-in/SignInPage.tsx`

- A `<form>` with an email input,

a password input, and a submit button. All native, all unstyled. No design tokens yet — **PLATFORM-10-WEB (CRM-25)** owns those.
- Submit
handler: **no network call**. Call `signIn('stub-token')` from `useAuth()` and `use

Navigate()` to `/`. - Include a visible note (aria-live text or a `

` beside the form)

saying **"Real sign-in is not implemented yet — IDENTITY-1-API replaces this stub."**

#### Create file: `web/src/pages/home/HomePage.tsx`

- A min
imal authenticated landing (an `<h1>` with the product name from taxonomy, no colour). This is the anchor the guard t

ests against; feature screens land here in their own stories.

### 4 — Shared HTTP client

#### Create file: `web/src/shared/api/base-url.ts`

-
Export a constant `API_BASE_URL = '/api/v1'`. One place; the client never hardcodes the prefix elsewhere. The pr

efix comes from **PLATFORM-6-API (CRM-21)**.

#### Create file: `web/src/shared/api/errors.ts`

- Export a mirror of the API's frozen cat
alogue as a **`type ApiErrorCode`** union (`'BAD_REQUEST' | 'UNAUTHENTICATED' | 'FORBIDDEN' | 'NOT
_FOUND' | 'CONFLICT' | 'VALIDATION_FAILED' | 'RATE_LIMITED' | 'INTERNAL'`). List the codes literally from `api/src/platform/http/errors.js
` (`DOCUMENTED`, lines 15–24). Add a comment saying the API's `DOCUMENTED` map is the source of truth;

when a new code is added there, add it here in the same commit.
- Export `class ApiError extends Error` with:
  - `status: number` — from the HTTP response.
  -

`code: string` — the API's code, or `'INTERNAL'` when the body is missing / malformed.
  - `requestId: string | null`.
  - `fields?: string[]` — only present when the API

sent one (422). **Names only** (L-9). Never any value.
- Do **not** map codes to user-facing sentences. That bel

ongs to the translations story; this client surfaces `code` as-is.

#### Create file: `web/src/shared/api/client.ts`

- Export a single

function `request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T>`.
- Prefix `path` with `API_BASE_URL`

when it starts with `/`; reject when it does not.
- Attach `Content-Type: application/json` when a body is present; attach `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when
the auth context has one (inject the token via a small `setAuthTokenGetter(fn)` se

am so the client stays free of a React import — `app/auth-context.tsx` registers the getter on mount).
- On response:
  - `response.ok` (2

xx): return `await response.json()` (or `undefined` on 204).
  - non-2xx: read the body defensively, and throw `new ApiError({ status, code, requestId, fields })`. When
the body is not valid JSON, or is missing `code`, use `'INTERNAL'` as the code and pass `requestId` from the `x-request-id` response header if

present (that header is set by PLATFORM-3-API's request-id middleware).
- On network failure (`fetch` rejects):

throw `new ApiError({ status: 0, code: 'INTERNAL', requestId: null })`.
- **No** try/catch swallows the `code`; the code is the wh

ole point.

### 5 — The shared loading hook

#### Create file: `web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.ts`

- One hook, four exports? No
— one. Signature: `function useRequest<T>(): { status: 'idle' | 'loading' | 'success' | 'error', data: T | null, error: ApiError | null, run: (task: () => Promise<T>) =>

Promise<T> }`.
- Internally uses `useReducer` (or `useState`) to move through the four states.
- `run(task)` s
ets `loading`, awaits `task()`, then sets `success` with `data` or `error` with the caught `ApiError`. Non-`ApiError` throws are wrapped as `

ApiError({ status: 0, code: 'INTERNAL' })` so the hook's `error.code` is always a string.
- **C
ancels stale updates**: track a monotonic request id inside the hook; when `run` is called again before the previous resolves, dr

op the earlier result.
- Add a top-of-file comment: **"This hook is the only place a web screen expresses loading. A screen that reimplements it is a

bug — see acceptance criterion 4."**

#### Create file: `web/src/shared/hooks/index.ts`

- Re-export `useRequest` so pages import from `../../shared/hooks`

, not the file.

### 6 — Test setup for this story

Do **not** stand up the full test harness — that is **PLATFORM-11-WEB**. This

story ships only what it needs to prove its own criteria.

#### Create file: `web/src/testing/setup.ts`

- Import `@testing-library/jest-dom`.
- Install a minimal in
-memory `localStorage` polyfill on `globalThis` **before** any test file loads. The rationale is written in the intake and in `## PLATFORM-11-WEB` (~
lines 153–155): Node 26 defines a `localStorage` global that throws unless started with a flag, and jsdom's returns `undefined`. Provide a `
Map`-backed implementation with `getItem`, `setItem`, `removeItem`, `clear`, `key`, `length`. Assign it with `Object.defineProper

ty(globalThis, 'localStorage', { value, writable: true })` so the tests can also swap it if needed.
- Add a

comment naming **PLATFORM-11-WEB** as the story that replaces this file with the full harness.

---

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **No st

ored token on first load** — `readStoredToken()` returns `null`; `RequireAuth` redirects to `/sign-in`. Enforced in `web/src/app/require-auth.tsx`.
- **Cor
rupt / empty string token in `localStorage`** — treat empty string as absent (`isAuthenticated = Boolean(token && token.length > 0)`). En

forced in `web/src/app/auth-context.tsx`.
- **`localStorage` unavailable** (Safari private mode; Node 26 in a test that skipped the set
up file) — the read is wrapped in `try/catch` and returns `null`; the write logs nothing and is a no-op. Enforced in `web/

src/app/auth-context.tsx`.
- **API returns a body that is not JSON** (HTML error page from a proxy) — `client.ts` catches the `S
yntaxError` from `response.json()`, throws `ApiError({ code: 'INTERNAL', status, requestId: header ?? null })`. Enforced in `web/

src/shared/api/client.ts`.
- **API returns 422 with `fields`** — `ApiError.fields` is populated. Screens later render field-
scoped messages; this story just carries the array through. **Never** log or echo a subm

itted value (L-9).
- **`useRequest` called twice concurrently** — the second `run` wins; the first's resolution is dropped. Enforced by the monotonic id in `web

/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.ts`.
- **Unmatched route** — falls through to the catch-all in `AppRoutes`, which redirects to `/`. From there, `RequireAu

th` sends the visitor onward to `/sign-in` if needed.
- **Structure violation** (a `
shared/` module importing from `pages/`) — this story does **not** enforce it. **PLATFORM-15-ALL** owns that check (

L-10 / L-13). Do not add a source-scan test here.

---

Add only the tests that prove **this story's** five

x`** — seed `localStorage` with `AUTH_TOKEN_KEY` before mount; render `<App />` at `/`; assert the home landing renders (not the sign-in form). This is

4. **`web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.test.tsx`** — with `@testing-library/react`'

5. **`web/src/pages/sign-in/SignInPage.test.tsx`** — render the page
; submit the form; assert the auth context now reports `isAuthenticated === true` and the user is navigated to `/`. This proves the seam a screen uses, not a real

endpoint.

ward → the structure check fails") is proven by **PLATFORM-15-ALL** when that story ships its script (L-10, L-13). Reference this explicitly in a comment at

op `routes.test.tsx`.

Test file suffix is `.test.ts` / `.test.tsx`, matching the API conv

ention (`api/src/**/*.test.js`) as closely as the TypeScript stack allows.
